metadata.description: Red pixel lettering spells FLY FREE. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Floating terraces surround the motif, with sheltered harbours along the lower route. 4 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 8 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
